questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of crafting an event brand for a school event?

options.text: To make the event more expensive by adding logos and themes
To create a unique and memorable identity that helps people recognize and remember the event
To confuse attendees with complex designs and names
To avoid using social media for promotion

correct_answer.text: To create a unique and memorable identity that helps people recognize and remember the event

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an effective social media strategy for promoting a school event on TikTok?

options.text: Posting long, detailed videos explaining every aspect of the event
Creating short, trendy videos with popular sounds or challenges to grab attention
Avoiding hashtags to keep the event exclusive
Posting only once a month to avoid annoying followers

correct_answer.text: Creating short, trendy videos with popular sounds or challenges to grab attention

questions.question_text: How can traditional promotion methods like flyers be made more interactive for a high school audience?

options.text: By using small, hard-to-read text to save space
By placing them only in teachers’ lounges where students can’t see them
By adding a QR code that links to a signup form or sneak peek video
By making them black and white to save on printing costs

correct_answer.text: By adding a QR code that links to a signup form or sneak peek video

questions.question_text: Why is engaging your audience early an important part of event promotion?

options.text: It ensures that tickets are more expensive closer to the event date
It gives people time to plan to attend and builds excitement well before the event
It prevents anyone from knowing about the event until the last minute
It makes the event planning process more complicated

correct_answer.text: It gives people time to plan to attend and builds excitement well before the event
